title: Add installer Compose startup and healthchecks

context.summary: Extend installer execution from prepare-only filesystem work to Docker Compose startup through runtime health checks.
context.background: TASK-65 added journaled prepare execution for MINDORY_HOME files. This task adds Docker command execution as a separate opt-in layer while keeping first project/token provisioning for TASK-67.

in: Add installer command runner abstraction for Docker Compose commands.
Implement pull/build, infrastructure startup, migration run, runtime startup and healthcheck steps.
Wait for Compose service health and API readiness with configurable timeout.
Rollback started Compose services with compose down on failure.
Expose a CLI command that runs prepare plus Compose startup and reports pending provisioning steps.
Add fake-runner validation so normal checks do not mutate Docker.
out: Running live Docker installer acceptance by default.

acceptance_criteria: Installer execution can run through health-check and stop before create-first-token.
Docker Compose commands are generated with selected profiles, env file and MINDORY_HOME.
Healthcheck waits for Postgres, Redis, migrate, API, worker and MCP readiness.
Failed Compose/startup steps roll back completed compose_down rollback steps.
CLI exposes a start command distinct from prepare and reports pending provisioning.
pnpm check validates the Compose startup path with fake command/fetch runners.

manual_checks: Confirm default installer acceptance still avoids live Docker mutation.

risks: Compose build context can differ between source checkout and future release bundle.
Healthcheck parsing must tolerate different Docker Compose JSON formats.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
